synopsis: Duality AI Falcon is a commercial Unreal Engine digital-twin simulator, with Falcon Editor and web-accessed FalconCloud, listed among complete or near-complete simulation platforms [f8418, f8346]. Its demonstrated application evidence is military off-road use through DARPA RACER-Sim and NASA JPL, rather than construction or mining; Falcon with the Neya autonomy stack is an explicitly supported RACER-Sim combination [f15889, f8423, f8707]. Its non-commercial education license costs USD 20 per month and launched on 20 November 2024, but commercial pricing was not found [f8424, f8425, f15888]. Sensor capabilities were not verified, and although FalconCloud was the latest release entry found, its release date was unavailable [f8979, f8982]. The glossary places Falcon among off-road-relevant research and military programs, while the underlying Unreal Engine editors are described as domain-neutral; editor generality therefore does not establish demonstrated construction or mining use [f16078, f9158, f15889].
